name: github
description: A full git + GitHub client bound to a Decillion space: connect a GitHub account (OAuth), then browse organizations and repositories and clone, branch, stage, commit, push, pull, merge, open and merge pull requests, and manage issues.
usecases: you need to look at or change code in a GitHub repository the space is connected to — read files, branches, commits, diffs
you need to clone a repository into the space and work on it, then commit and push your changes
you need to open, review or merge a pull request, or create/close issues
you need to see an organization's repositories and their state (open PRs, default branch, permissions)
howToTalk: Signal it with `function` naming the operation. Connection: `status` (default), `orgs`, `disconnect`, `set_shared`. Read: `repos` (optionally `org`), `repo`, `branches`, `commits`, `pulls`, `get_pull`, `issues` — all take `repo` = "owner/name". Git on the space's shared sandbox machine: `clone`, `pull`, `push`, `stage` (aka `add`; optional `files`, default all), `unstage` (optional `files`, default all), `commit` (needs `message`; stages everything by default, or pass `staged_only: true` to commit only what you've already staged, or `files` to narrow the staging), `checkout` (`branch`, optional `create`), `merge` (`branch`), `git_status` (returns per-file staged/unstaged breakdown), `git_log`, `read_file`/`write_file`/`delete_file`/`list_dir` (`path`), `list_cloned`. A typical flow: edit files, `stage` the ones you want, then `commit` with `staged_only: true`, then `push`. GitHub write: `create_pull` (`title`,`head`,`base`), `merge_pull` (`number`, optional `merge_method`), `update_pull`, `create_issue` (`title`). All filesystem/git work runs on the space's cloud sandbox (the same machine your other tools use), so clones are shared by the whole space. The space and the connected account are already bound — never pass a space id or a token.
prompt: Use this to actually work with the space's GitHub: read and change code, and drive git and GitHub. Name the operation with `function`. The space is connected to one GitHub account by a human member; you act as that account. Repositories are addressed as `repo`="owner/name". All clones and file changes happen on the space's shared cloud sandbox (the same machine as the Files tool), so clone a repo before running git on it and everyone in the space sees the same files.

function.description: operation: status (default) | orgs | repos | repo | branches | commits | pulls | get_pull | issues | clone | pull | push | stage | unstage | commit | checkout | merge | git_status | git_log | list_cloned | read_file | write_file | delete_file | list_dir | create_pull | merge_pull | update_pull | create_issue | disconnect | set_shared

org.description: for repos: limit to one organization's repositories

files.description: for stage/unstage/commit: the paths to act on (default: all changes)

staged_only.description: for commit: commit only what is already staged, without staging first

path.description: for read_file/write_file/list_dir: a path inside the cloned repo

number.description: for get_pull/merge_pull/update_pull: the pull request number

tools.name: status
tools.desc: report whether the space is connected to GitHub, as which account, whether the connection is shared, and whether the caller may use/manage it

tools.name: orgs
tools.desc: list the connected user and the organizations they granted access to

tools.name: repos
tools.desc: list repositories the connection can see; pass `org` to scope to one organization

org.desc: optional organization login to scope to

tools.name: repo
tools.desc: details for one repository (default branch, permissions, description, counts)

tools.name: branches
tools.desc: list a repository's branches with their head SHA and protection

tools.name: commits
tools.desc: recent commits on a repository (optionally a `branch` or `path`)

tools.name: pulls
tools.desc: list pull requests (default state open)

tools.name: get_pull
tools.desc: one pull request with its mergeability

tools.name: create_pull
tools.desc: open a pull request

tools.name: merge_pull
tools.desc: merge a pull request

tools.name: update_pull
tools.desc: edit a pull request (title/body/state); set state to closed to close it

tools.name: issues
tools.desc: list issues (default state open)

tools.name: create_issue
tools.desc: open an issue

tools.name: clone
tools.desc: clone a repository into the space (idempotent — fetches when already cloned)

tools.name: pull
tools.desc: git pull the cloned repository from origin

tools.name: stage
tools.desc: stage changes into the index without committing (git add); returns the resulting staged/unstaged breakdown

files.desc: optional file list (default: stage all changes)

tools.name: unstage
tools.desc: remove changes from the index without discarding your edits (git reset); returns the resulting staged/unstaged breakdown

tools.name: commit
tools.desc: commit changes in the cloned repository; stages everything first by default, or pass staged_only=true to commit only what is already staged

files.desc: optional file list to stage (default: all changes)

staged_only.desc: commit only what is already staged, staging nothing

tools.name: push
tools.desc: git push the cloned repository to origin

tools.name: checkout
tools.desc: switch branches (or create one with `create`)

tools.name: merge
tools.desc: git merge a branch into the current one in the clone

tools.name: git_status
tools.desc: porcelain status + current branch of the cloned repository

tools.name: git_log
tools.desc: recent local commits of the cloned repository

tools.name: read_file
tools.desc: read a file out of a cloned repository

tools.name: write_file
tools.desc: create or overwrite a file in a cloned repository (on the space's sandbox)

tools.name: delete_file
tools.desc: delete a file or directory in a cloned repository (on the space's sandbox)

tools.name: list_dir
tools.desc: list a directory inside a cloned repository as structured {name,type,size} rows

tools.name: list_cloned
tools.desc: list the repositories cloned into this space

tools.name: oauth_start
tools.desc: begin the GitHub OAuth web flow (front-end only); returns the authorize URL to open in a browser tab

tools.name: oauth_wait
tools.desc: long-poll until the OAuth callback stores the token (front-end only); returns connected/pending/expired

tools.name: set_shared
tools.desc: owner-only: toggle whether the rest of the space (people and agents) may use the connection

shared.desc: true to share with the space, false to keep private to the connecting member

tools.name: disconnect
tools.desc: owner-only: remove the stored GitHub token and connection for the space
